name: Sunkissed Cool by Julia Nimke
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Sunkissed Cool recipe is a variation of the Sunkissed Warmth recipe. It adds a vintage touch to your images, with the mid-tones and highlights shifted towards a blue hue, while keeping warm shadow tones to create a nice balance. It’s perfect for bright daylight situations, especially when you want to enhance the color of a blue sky. This recipe transforms the scene into a nostalgic yet refreshing memory, whether it’s portraits, still life, or city snaps.
